question.prompt: The weekly pocket money amounts (in yuan) for 6 students in a class are 10, 10, 15, 15, 20, 50. By how many yuan does the mean exceed the median?

solutions.explanation: Mean \(=120\div6=20\); median \(=(15+15)\div2=15\). The difference is 5, showing that the extremely large value 50 raises the mean.
solutions.title: Calculate the mean and median
